priceSource: PriceCharting ungraded (used) — not SNKRDUNK, not TCGPlayer
universe: English Base Set 1st Edition, Shadowless, Unlimited, and Base Set 2 raw singles
anchorRule: 2023-01-01 or the first later month with >= 15 priced cards = 1000
cadenceNote: PriceCharting public VGPC.chart_data is one ungraded (used) point per month. Weekly points are not published on that chart and are not interpolated.
basketRule: Fixed chase baskets: English Base Set and Base Set 2, Holo Rare + Rare (catalog numbers 1–22 and 70–79, the same cut as market-vintage). Machamp #8 is included only when that printing has a catalog slug. Energy (including Double Colorless #96), commons, uncommons, sealed, and error variants are omitted. Slugs are copied from data/base-psa-pop/catalog.json. Product ids are copied from console JSON.
